description: Expected Item 1A changes between the two controlled Acme fixtures (FY2024 -> FY2025). This is a CONTROLLED DETECTOR EVALUATION over two synthetic demo filings written for this repository — it is not a production-quality financial benchmark, and metrics computed against it say nothing about real-filing accuracy.
matching_semantics: A detected change matches an expected change iff (unit_key, change_type) are both equal, where unit_key is the detector's normalized heading slug. Undetermined and failed detector outputs count in the detected set (they lower precision); they are never silently excluded.

expected_changes.why: FY2025 adds two attempted intrusion events, raises cyber insurance from $35M to $50M, and reports zero-trust rollout complete (phased rollout began in FY2024).
FY2025 adds the December 2025 SEC AI-rule proposal and the March 2025 deficiency letter; FY2024 reported no deficiencies.
The AI and model risk factor exists only in the FY2025 filing.
The LIBOR/reference-rate transition risk factor exists only in the FY2024 filing.

expected_unchanged_units.why: The Item 1A introductory paragraph is byte-identical in both filings; it must align and must NOT be emitted as a change.
